verdict.rationale: The public API documents issuing virtual cards (VCN) for travel and custom uses, with top-up, reveal and cancel operations, and Update VCN can raise the ceiling, change the validity window and adjust controls. A separate corporate-cards API lists, blocks and unblocks cards, which covers locking. missing for 10: API issuance of standard corporate cards (only VCNs are shown being created), control updates for corporate cards beyond block/unblock, independent or hands-on corroboration.
